Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 34 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Rajesh - 45 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Tanay stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Tanay: "What lovely weather!"

[Tanay opens his umbrella.]

Sonali: "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay puts on his raincoat.]

Tanay: "That was fun!"

[The rain stops.]

Tanay: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Sonali and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Let's begin."

[Tanay talks to his father on the phone.]

Tanay: "Oh wow!"

[Tanay types on his laptop.]

Tanay: "That was fun!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Let's begin."

[Tanay throws the ball to Mother.]

Sonali: "Hey, look at that!"

[Tanay kicks the football hard.]

Tanay (laughing): "Mom, look at this."

[Tanay goes down the slide.]

Tanay: "What next?"

[Tanay plays with his dog.]

Tanay: "And then?"

[Tanay feeds the birds.]

Tanay: "This is amazing!"

[Tanay does yoga on a mat.]

Sonali: "I really enjoyed today."
